The facts relevant for disposal of the matter are as follows: The appellant Abdus Sobhan filed Civil Appeal No. 9 of 1978 against the judgment and decree dated August 18, 1977 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court of Bangladesh in First Appeal Nos. 16 and 17 of 1977 reversing those passed by the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong in Other Suit No. 39 of 1975 and dismissing the suit. The appellant instituted the suit for declaration of his title in the suit land and recovery of possession thereof and for mandatory injunction requiring respondent 4, Padma Petroleum formerly known as Daud Petroleum Limited to transfer the agency of the petrol pump installed therein. In the suit he claimed that the suit land consisting of commercial plot Nos. 1 and 2 of the Cantonment of Chittagong then belonging to the Government of Pakistan and managed through the Ministry of Defense were leased out by auction for 30 years to Ayaz Bahadur Khan respondent 1, being the highest bidder and out of the consideration of Tk. 93,000/- he paid Tk. 23,520/- on December 12, 1965 and the respondent being unable to pay the balance entered into an agreement with the Daud Petroleum Limited for subletting the suit land for a period of 30 years, on condition of the sub-lessee constructing a petrol pump and service station on the same and granting dealership in petroleum to the respondent. As per agreement possession of the suit land was delivered to the Daud Petroleum and the latter constructed the petrol pump and respondent 1 started selling petroleum as a dealer of daud Petroleum from 1971. In February 1972 the respondent 1 approached the appellant for sale of the property and the latter agreed to purchase the same at a consideration of Tk. 83,000/- out of which Tk. 60,000/ was paid on different dates and an agreement was executed on June 4, 1972 and the balance Tk. 23,000/- was paid on July 4, 1972 and a general power of attorney was executed by the respondent on September 30, 1972 is favour of the appellant authorizing him to do all acts necessary for protecting the property and for disposing of the suit land. On the instruction of the respondent a deed of lease was executed by the military authority in respect of the suit land on April 20, 1973 showing the appellant as the 'nominee' of the respondent and the lease deed was registered on April 21, 1973. After execution of the lease deed the appellant started asserting the lessee's right in the suit land, whereupon the respondent cancelled his general power of attorney and sent necessary instructions to the military authority and the Padma Petroleum totally denying the agreement dated June 4, 1972 for sale of the property with the appellant. The appellant claiming to be the sole lessee under the lease instituted the suit which was decreed by the trial Court but on appeal the High Court dismissed it and the appellant's appeal to this Court by leave was dismissed on August 25, 1978.
